about_the_game:
High Fructose is a high-speed, semi-open roguelite FPS set in sprawling, procedurally generated battlefields. Every run drops you into a new playground built for wall-running, dashing, double-jumping, and total movement freedom. Explore, improvise, and unleash chaos with your evolving arsenal.

Play as the Fox, the first of your superpowered animal ninjas waging war against a fruit-infested world twisted by demonic corruption. Slice, smash, and blast your way through waves of cursed produce to cleanse the land.

Future updates may introduce additional playable characters (such as Elephant, Wolverine, or Monkey), new enemies, expanded recipe lists, and new environments — all subject to change based on development needs and community feedback.

Early Access means many systems are still rough. Advanced mechanics exist but aren't always obvious, controls need refinement, and onboarding is actively being improved based on your feedback.

KEY FEATURES

⚡ Movement-Based Combat
Wall-run, air-dash, double-jump, and bend time to stay in constant motion. Experiment with momentum and positioning to find powerful combinations.

🍉 Evolving Demonic Fruit Enemies
Banana Snakes, Cherry Cannons, Pumpkin Pyros, Dragonfruit Dragons — each run mutates the corrupted fruit in new and twisted ways.

🔪 One Manual Weapon, Auto-Fire Everything Else
You swing the blade. Everything else unleashes itself. Stay focused on movement and feel like a speeding blender of destruction.

🌳 Procedural Battlefields
Semi-open orchards warped by corruption. Fresh layouts, paths, and elevation challenges every run.

🥣 Combat Recipes
Kill fruit to complete recipes that unleash powerful effects — heals, shields, summons, explosions, or corruption-cleansing bursts.

💰 Between-Wave Shop
Buy new weapons, perks, and wild upgrades between waves to shape your build.

🌱 Persistent Seed Upgrades
Earn seeds, grow your power, unlock new dark recipes, and push deeper into the corruption each run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

short_description: High Fructose is a first-person survivor-like roguelite where weapons fire automatically while you dash, wall-run, and manually slash through demon fruit with fast-paced melee combat. Build powerful loadouts between waves with weapons, items, and recipes.
